title: A Characterization of the $M$-tests Under Nearly Integrated Nearly White Noise
abstract: arXiv:2609.30504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We derive the limiting distributions of the $M$-test family of unit root statistics in the nearly integrated nearly white noise (NINW) framework introduced by Nabeya and Perron (1994) in the case of an unknown linear time trend. In the case of known long run variance (LRV), the limiting distributions of the $M^{GLS}$ tests are contaminated by additional noise terms as a result of quasi differencing whereas these terms are less present in the $M^{OLS}$ limiting distributions, both of which display conservative properties under conventional critical values. Furthermore, we prove the Gaussian power envelope in the NINW model is asymptotically equivalent to the standard envelope of Elliott, Rothenberg, and Stock (1996), and that the oracle $M$-tests have inefficient power relative to this benchmark. translated_title: 近似积分近似白噪声下M检验的刻画
translated_abstract: 我们在Nabeya和Perron（1994）提出的近似积分近似白噪声（NINW）框架下，针对未知线性时间趋势的情形，推导了M检验族单位根统计量的极限分布。在长期方差（LRV）已知的情形下，由于准差分的作用，M^{GLS}检验的极限分布受到额外噪声项的污染，而这些噪声项在M^{OLS}的极限分布中出现得较少，二者在常规临界值下均表现出保守性质。此外，我们证明了NINW模型下的高斯功效包络渐近等价于Elliott、Rothenberg和Stock（1996）的标准包络，且oracle M检验相对于该基准具有较低的功效。随后我们推导了可行统计量的极限分布，并表明常用的基于自回归的LRV估计会导致高估……
tldr: 本文在NINW框架下推导了M检验族单位根统计量的极限分布，证明了NINW模型的高斯功效包络渐近等价于Elliott-Rothenberg-Stock标准包络，并揭示了oracle M检验相对该基准功效不足以及可行统计量中常用自回归LRV估计的高估问题。
en_tdlr: This paper derives the limiting distributions of the M-test family of unit root statistics under the NINW framework, proves that the Gaussian power envelope in the NINW model is asymptotically equivalent to the standard Elliott-Rothenberg-Stock envelope, and shows that the oracle M-tests are power-inefficient relative to this benchmark, with feasible statistics suffering from overestimation by the commonly used autoregressive LRV estimate.
